name: Anzus
cooked: One addition that could help nontechnical readers is a short comparison of what each approach means for the user: can they make partial withdrawals, change the recovery destination, recover after losing a device, and handle unexpectedly high fees? That would make the differences easier to understand without needing to know how each proposal works internally.
